Not just volume that sits there for a few months, but a treatment that actually helps your skin rebuild over time. At Sansa Med Spa, a doctor-owned boutique med spa in Nashua, we offer Radiesse® — a collagen biostimulator that provides immediate improvement while triggering lasting collagen production beneath the skin. It works differently than traditional filler. And for the right patient, the results reflect that difference. What Are Collagen Biostimulators? Collagen biostimulators are injectable treatments that do two things at once. They add volume immediately, and they stimulate your body to produce new collagen over time. As that collagen builds, it gradually fills in areas that have lost structure and firmness — creating results that look natural because they're largely made by your own skin. Traditional hyaluronic acid fillers, like the ones used for lip enhancement, work primarily by physically adding volume. Biostimulators go a step further by prompting the body's own repair process. The improvement you see at six months is largely collagen your body built in response to treatment. Radiesse® is the biostimulator we use at Sansa. It's made of calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) microspheres suspended in a gel carrier. The gel provides immediate volume on the day of treatment. Over the following months, the microspheres are gradually absorbed while collagen forms around them, leaving behind your body's own structural improvement. What Can Radiesse® Help With? Radiesse® is a versatile treatment that works well across multiple areas of the face and body. It's particularly effective for concerns related to volume loss, skin laxity, and structural definition. It may help with: Nasolabial folds (smile lines) Marionette lines Cheek, temple, and midface volume loss Jawline definition Chin augmentation Cheekbone enhancement Perioral lines (around the mouth) Volume restoration in the back of the hands Acne scarring (saucerized type) Overall skin texture and firmness Neck and décolletage tightening Knee and elbow skin tightening Buttock lifting and smoothing If you're not sure whether Radiesse® is the right fit for your specific concern, we'll work through that together during your consultation. How Is Radiesse® Different From Regular Filler? The key difference is longevity and mechanism. Hyaluronic acid fillers — like RHA® and Revanesse® Versa™, which we use for lip enhancement — add volume by filling space. They're excellent for precise, reversible results in areas like the lips, under-eyes, and fine lines. Radiesse® works on a longer timeline. The immediate result is visible on day one, but the full effect develops over several months as new collagen forms. Results can last up to two years or more, which is meaningfully longer than most HA fillers. Radiesse® is also not reversible the way HA fillers are, which is one reason a thorough consultation matters. We want to make sure the treatment is the right choice for your goals and anatomy before we proceed. Book an appointment Why Choose a Doctor-Owned Med Spa in Nashua for Collagen Biostimulators? That step is how we make sure we're recommending the right approach for you. What Results Can You Expect? You'll see immediate improvement on the day of treatment as the gel carrier adds volume. Over the following weeks and months, collagen production continues to build, and the results deepen and refine naturally. Most patients benefit from a series of 2 to 3 sessions spaced several weeks apart for optimal results. Results can last up to two years or more, though individual longevity depends on the area treated, the amount used, and how your body responds. Downtime is minimal. Most patients experience mild redness, swelling, or bruising at the injection sites that resolves within a few days. You can return to your normal activities right away. Medical suitability required. The honest answer is that it depends on your specific concerns, how much downtime you're comfortable with, and what you're hoping to achieve. Here's a simple way to think about it: If your primary concern is significant skin laxity, jowling, or deeper remodeling — Morpheus8 is likely the right starting point. If you want RF-based tightening with no needles and no downtime — Forma is worth discussing. If texture, pigmentation, and surface clarity are your main goals alongside mild laxity — UltraGlo may be the best fit. And in some cases, a combination approach makes sense. We can talk through all of it during your consultation. Why Choose a Doctor-Owned Med Spa in Nashua for Skin Tightening? The settings, depth, and technique used for these treatments matter. Frequently Asked Questions About Collagen Biostimulators in Nashua, NH How is Radiesse® different from Sculptra®? Both are collagen biostimulators, but they're made of different materials. Radiesse® uses calcium hydroxylapatite microspheres and provides immediate volume alongside collagen stimulation. Sculptra® uses poly-L-lactic acid and works more gradually with little immediate volume effect. We currently offer Radiesse® at Sansa — if you have questions about which type of biostimulator might suit your goals, we'll discuss that at your consultation. When will I see results? You'll see immediate improvement on the day of treatment. More significant results develop over several months as your body produces new collagen. The final outcome is a gradual, natural-looking improvement that reflects your own skin's response. How long do results last? Radiesse® results can last up to two years or more, depending on the area treated and individual factors. Regular follow-up treatments can help maintain results over time. Is treatment painful? Most patients experience minimal discomfort — typically a brief pinch at the injection site. A numbing cream can be applied beforehand to keep you comfortable throughout the treatment. Is there downtime? Downtime is minimal. You may experience mild redness, swelling, or bruising that typically resolves within a few days. Most patients return to their regular activities the same day. Who is a good candidate for Radiesse®? Radiesse® is a good fit for patients dealing with volume loss, skin laxity, or structural changes in the face or body who are looking for longer-lasting results than traditional HA filler provides. A consultation is required to assess suitability and confirm it's the right treatment for your goals. What is the best med spa for collagen biostimulators in Nashua, NH?
